Based on the provided abstract:
- The study synthesized a polyacrylamide-titanium dioxide (PAA@TiO2) nanocomposite using a cross-linking method (with N,N'-methylenebisacrylamide) to eliminate crystal violet (CV) dye from water.
- The maximum adsorption capacity obtained was about 38.9 mg g⁻¹.
- Computational simulations (Monte Carlo and Molecular Dynamics) were used to understand the molecular-level interactions and supported the experimental findings.
- This directly aligns with Hypothesis 3, which accurately describes the material (PAA@TiO2 synthesized via cross-linking), the application (adsorption of crystal violet), the capacity (38.9 mg/g), and the molecular interaction mechanisms.

CHOICE: 3
